    , "                    WHERE tmp_upt.digital_party_id = ipd.digital_party_id "

    , "             FROM ", v_project_storage, ".", v_dataset_master_stage, ".","tmp_iden_party_digital_faltante_base_e3_upt3 tmp_upt "

        --TEMPORAL: CARGA TEMPORAL CON LA BASE DEL ESCENARIO 4 - PARTE 2 (PREVIA A LA ACTUALIZACION DE LOS DATOS)

    "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ", v_project_storage, ".", v_dataset_master_stage, ".","tmp_iden_party_digital_faltante_base_e4_upt AS "
    
    ,"WITH TMP_EVENT_EMAIL AS ( SELECT digital_party_id  ,hash_email,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY digital_party_id ORDER BY process_date DESC) AS rank "
        ," FROM  ", v_project_storage, ".", v_dataset_master_stage, ".tmp_base_iden_party_digital   WHERE hash_email IS NOT NULL )"
        ," , TMP_EVENT_HASH_ID AS ( SELECT digital_party_id  ,hash_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY digital_party_id ORDER BY process_date DESC) AS rank "
        ," FROM  ", v_project_storage, ".", v_dataset_master_stage, ".tmp_base_iden_party_digital   WHERE hash_id IS NOT NULL )"
    
    , "SELECT tab.* "
    , " , SHA256(IFNULL(tab.digital_party_id,'') "
    , " || IFNULL(tab.party_id,'') "
    , " || IFNULL(tab.hash_id,'') "

    , "SELECT a.digital_party_id,a.itc_company_id,a.itc_company_name,a.business_unit_id,a.business_unit"

    , "FROM ", v_project_storage, ".", v_dataset_master_stage, ".", "tmp_iden_party_digital_faltante_base_e4 a "
    , "LEFT JOIN TMP_EVENT_EMAIL a2 "
    , "ON(a2.digital_party_id = a.digital_party_id)  and a2.rank=1 "

    , "LEFT JOIN ", v_project_storage, ".", v_dataset_master_stage, ".", "tmp_iden_party_digital_m_party_pii b "
    , "ON(b.hash_email = a2.hash_email) "
    , "LEFT JOIN ", v_project_storage, ".", v_dataset_master_stage, ".", "tmp_iden_digital_party_iden_party_id c "

    , "LEFT JOIN TMP_EVENT_HASH_ID a3 "

    , ") tab"

    --UPDATE: ACTUALIZACION DE LA IDEN_PARTY_DIGITAL CON LA BASE DEL ESCENARIO 4

    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE '''

        SELECT digital_party_id FROM ''' || v_project_storage || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_stage || '''.tmp_base_iden_party_digital_cleaned 
        WHERE  hash_id  IS NOT NULL AND hash_email IS NOT NULL AND party_id IS NOT NULL
         )
    ''';


    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE '''
    DELETE FROM ''' || v_project_storage || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_stage || '''.tmp_base_iden_party_digital_cleaned  
    WHERE hash_id  IS NULL AND hash_email IS NOT NULL

        SELECT CONCAT(digital_party_id,'-',ifnull(hash_email ,'0')  )
        FROM ''' || v_project_storage || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_stage || '''.tmp_base_iden_party_digital_cleaned 
        WHERE  hash_id  IS NOT NULL AND hash_email IS NOT NULL 
         )
    ''';


    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE '''
    DELETE FROM ''' || v_project_storage || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_stage || '''.tmp_base_iden_party_digital_cleaned  
    WHERE hash_id  IS NOT NULL AND hash_email IS NULL 
    AND CONCAT(digital_party_id,'-',ifnull(hash_id ,'0') ) IN (
        SELECT CONCAT(digital_party_id,'-',ifnull(hash_id ,'0')  )
        FROM ''' || v_project_storage || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_stage || '''.tmp_base_iden_party_digital_cleaned 
        WHERE  hash_id  IS NOT NULL AND hash_email IS NOT NULL 
         )
    ''';
    
    
    

    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE '''
    DELETE FROM ''' || v_project_storage || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_stage || '''.tmp_base_iden_party_digital_cleaned  
    WHERE hash_id  IS NULL AND hash_email IS NULL AND party_id IS NULL
    AND digital_party_id IN (
    SELECT digital_party_id FROM ''' || v_project_sensitive || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_pii || '''.''' || v_table_iden_party_digital || '''  
    WHERE record_source=''' || "'" || v_record_source || "'" || '''
    AND itc_company_id = ''' || "'" || v_itc_company_id || "'" || '''
    AND ''' || IF(v_business_id IS NULL ,'''business_unit_id IS NULL''','''business_unit_id ='''|| "'" || v_business_id  || "'") || '''
     )
    ''';
    
    
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE '''
    DELETE FROM ''' || v_project_storage || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_stage || '''.tmp_base_iden_party_digital_cleaned  
    WHERE hash_id  IS NULL AND hash_email IS NOT NULL 
    AND CONCAT(digital_party_id,'-',ifnull(hash_email ,'0') ) IN 
    (SELECT CONCAT(digital_party_id,'-',ifnull(hash_email ,'0')) 
     FROM ''' || v_project_sensitive ||'''.''' || v_dataset_master_pii || '''.''' || v_table_iden_party_digital || ''' 
    WHERE record_source=''' || "'" || v_record_source || "'" || '''
    AND itc_company_id = ''' || "'" || v_itc_company_id || "'" || '''
    AND ''' || IF(v_business_id IS NULL ,'''business_unit_id IS NULL''','''business_unit_id ='''|| "'" || v_business_id  || "'") || '''
     )
    ''';
    
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE '''
    DELETE FROM ''' || v_project_storage || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_stage || '''.tmp_base_iden_party_digital_cleaned  
    WHERE hash_id  IS NOT NULL AND hash_email IS  NULL 
    AND CONCAT(digital_party_id,'-',ifnull(hash_id ,'0') ) IN 
    (SELECT CONCAT(digital_party_id,'-',ifnull(hash_id ,'0')) 
    FROM ''' || v_project_sensitive ||'''.''' || v_dataset_master_pii || '''.''' || v_table_iden_party_digital || ''' 
    WHERE record_source=''' || "'" || v_record_source || "'" || '''
    AND itc_company_id = ''' || "'" || v_itc_company_id || "'" || '''
    AND ''' || IF(v_business_id IS NULL ,'''business_unit_id IS NULL''','''business_unit_id ='''|| "'" || v_business_id  || "'") || '''
    )

    --TARGET: CARGA LA NUEVA INFORMACION EN LA TABLA IDEN_PARTY_DIGITAL

    USING (
        SELECT 
            process_date,
            itc_company_id,
            itc_company_name,
            business_unit_id,
            business_unit,

            hash_email,
            hash_id,
            party_id,

        SELECT 
            a.process_date,
            a.itc_company_id,
            a.itc_company_name,
            a.business_unit_id,
            a.business_unit,
            a.digital_party_id,
            b.hash_email, 
            b.hash_id,     
            b.party_id,    
            a.google_clientid,
            a.itc_clientid,
            a.hash_mobile1,
            a.hash_mobile2,
            a.hash_dni,
            a.hash_id_update_date,
            a.hash_email_update_date,
            a.record_source,
            a.hk_diff,
            a.load_date,
            a.creation_user
        FROM ''' || v_project_storage || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_stage || '''.tmp_base_iden_party_digital_cleaned a
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 
                google_clientid, itc_clientid, hash_email, hash_id, party_id,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY google_clientid ORDER BY IF(hash_email IS NULL, 0, 1) + IF(hash_id IS NULL, 0, 1) + IF(party_id IS NULL, 0, 2) DESC, process_date DESC) AS rank
            FROM 
            ''' || v_project_sensitive || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_pii || '''.''' || v_table_iden_party_digital || '''

            a.business_unit,
            a.digital_party_id,

    ) tmp

        IFNULL(tmp.digital_party_id, '0') = IFNULL(ipd.digital_party_id, '0')
        AND IFNULL(tmp.party_id, '0') = IFNULL(ipd.party_id, '0')

        party_id,

        itc_clientid,
        hash_mobile1,
        hash_mobile2,
        hash_dni,
        hash_id_update_date,
        hash_email_update_date,

        tmp.hash_mobile1,
        tmp.hash_mobile2,

        tmp.hk_diff,
        tmp.load_date,
        tmp.creation_user
    )

    WHEN MATCHED THEN

        hash_mobile2 = IFNULL(tmp.hash_mobile2, ipd.hash_mobile2),
        hash_dni = IFNULL(tmp.hash_dni, ipd.hash_dni)
    ''';

END

CREATE PROCEDURE `prd-izipay-data-operation`.adf_modelo_digital.sp_load_ga_iden_party_digital(v_itc_company_id STRING, v_itc_company_name STRING, v_business_id STRING, v_business_name STRING, v_record_source STRING, v_project_storage STRING, v_project_sensitive STRING, v_dataset_master_stage STRING, v_dataset_master_pii STRING, v_table_iden_party STRING, v_table_iden_party_digital STRING, p_table_ba_contact_info STRING, v_table_t_event STRING, p_process_start_date DATE, p_process_end_date DATE)
OPTIONS(
  strict_mode=true)
BEGIN
-- ULTIMA MODIFICACION : 2024-10-11 11:20
  
    DECLARE v_process_start_date DATE;
    DECLARE v_process_end_date DATE;
    DECLARE v_date_suffix_start STRING;
    DECLARE v_date_suffix_end STRING ;

    SET v_process_start_date = CASE WHEN p_process_start_date IS NULL OR p_process_start_date = '1900-01-01' THEN  CURRENT_DATE('America/Lima')-15  ELSE p_process_start_date END;
    SET v_process_end_date   = CASE WHEN p_process_end_date IS NULL OR p_process_end_date = '1900-01-01' THEN  CURRENT_DATE('America/Lima')    ELSE p_process_end_date END;

    /*
    ESCENARIOS VALIDOS EN LA DATA DE LA IDEN_PARTY_DIGITAL
    1) clientId:NO NULO 
    2) clientId:NO NULO & HASH_ID:NO NULO
    3) clientId:NO NULO & hASH_EMAIL:NO NULO
    4) clientId:NO NULO & HASH_ID:NO NULO & PARTY_ID:NO NULO
    */
    
    -- TEMPORAL: BA_CONTACT_INFO
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE CONCAT(
      "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ", v_project_storage, ".", v_dataset_master_stage, ".tmp_iden_party_digital_m_party_pii AS ",
      "  SELECT * EXCEPT(rank) FROM ( ",
      "    SELECT hash_email, party_id, process_date, ",
      "    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY hash_email ORDER BY process_date DESC, party_id DESC) AS rank ",
      "    FROM `", p_table_ba_contact_info, "` ",
      "  ) WHERE rank = 1"
    );
--crea una tabla temporal que contiene solo el registro más reciente para cada hash_email, 
--basado en la fecha de procesamiento y el party_id


    
    --TEMPORAL: CARGA TEMPORAL A PARTIR DE LA TABLA IDEN_PARTY 
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE CONCAT(  
    "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ", v_project_storage, ".", v_dataset_master_stage, ".", "tmp_iden_digital_party_iden_party AS "
    "SELECT * EXCEPT(rank) FROM ("
    , "SELECT party_id, hash_id,"
    , "ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY hash_id ORDER BY process_date DESC, party_id DESC) AS rank"
    , " FROM "
    , v_project_sensitive, ".", v_dataset_master_pii,".", v_table_iden_party, " i "
    , " WHERE itc_company_id = ", "'", v_itc_company_id, "'"
    , "  ) WHERE rank = 1"
    );

    --TEMPORAL: CARGA TEMPORAL A PARTIR DE LA TABLA IDEN_PARTY 
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE CONCAT(  
    "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ", v_project_storage, ".", v_dataset_master_stage, ".", "tmp_iden_digital_party_iden_party_id AS "
    "SELECT * EXCEPT(rank) FROM ("
    , "SELECT party_id, hash_id,"
    , "ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY party_id ORDER BY process_date DESC, hash_id DESC) AS rank"
    , " FROM "
    , v_project_sensitive, ".", v_dataset_master_pii,".", v_table_iden_party, " i "
    , " WHERE itc_company_id = ", "'", v_itc_company_id, "'"
    , "  ) WHERE rank = 1"
    );


    
--crea una tabla temporal que contiene valores únicos de party_id y hash_id para un itc_company_id específico  
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE '''
        CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ''' || v_project_storage || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_stage || '''.tmp_base_iden_party_digital AS
        WITH Tabla_iden AS (
            SELECT 
                a.process_date,
                a.itc_company_id,
                a.itc_company_name,
                a.business_unit_id,
                a.business_unit,
                TRIM(UPPER(a.hash_id)) AS hash_id,
                a.hash_email,
                a.party_id,
                a.digital_party_id,
                a.google_clientid,
                a.itc_clientid,
                a.hash_mobile1,
                a.hash_mobile2,
                a.hash_dni,
                ''' || "'" || v_record_source || "'" || ''' AS record_source,
                CAST(CURRENT_DATETIME('America/Lima') AS TIMESTAMP) AS hash_id_update_date,
                CAST(CURRENT_DATETIME('America/Lima') AS TIMESTAMP) AS hash_email_update_date,
                CAST(CURRENT_DATETIME('America/Lima') AS TIMESTAMP) AS load_date,
                SESSION_USER() AS creation_user
            FROM ''' || v_table_t_event || ''' a
            WHERE 
                a.process_date >= ''' || "'" || v_process_start_date || "'" || '''
                AND a.process_date <= ''' || "'" || v_process_end_date || "'" || '''
                AND a.itc_company_id = ''' || "'" || v_itc_company_id || "'" || 
                IF( v_business_id IS NULL, ' AND  a.business_unit_id IS NULL ' , " AND  a.business_unit_id = '"|| v_business_id  ||"'") || '''
                
        ) 
        SELECT
            MAX(process_date) AS process_date,  
            MAX(itc_company_id) AS itc_company_id,
            MAX(itc_company_name) AS itc_company_name,
            MAX(business_unit_id) AS business_unit_id,
            MAX(business_unit) AS business_unit,
            digital_party_id,
            MAX(google_clientid) AS google_clientid,
            MAX(itc_clientid) AS itc_clientid,
            hash_email,
            MAX(hash_mobile1) AS hash_mobile1,
            MAX(hash_mobile2) AS hash_mobile2,
            MAX(hash_dni) AS hash_dni,
            hash_id,
            party_id,
            MAX(hash_id_update_date) AS hash_id_update_date,
            MAX(hash_email_update_date) AS hash_email_update_date,
            MAX(record_source) AS record_source,
            MAX(load_date) AS load_date,
            MAX(creation_user) AS creation_user
        FROM Tabla_iden
        GROUP BY  
            digital_party_id, 
            party_id, 
            hash_id, 
            hash_email
    ''';



    -- Crear una tabla temporal para almacenar los datos sin duplicados
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE '''
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ''' || v_project_storage || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_stage || '''.tmp_base_iden_party_digital_cleaned AS
    
    WITH tab AS (
        SELECT 
            process_date,  
            itc_company_id,
            itc_company_name,
            business_unit_id,
            business_unit,
            digital_party_id,
            google_clientid,
            itc_clientid,
            hash_email,
            hash_mobile1,
            hash_mobile2,
            hash_dni,
            hash_id,
            party_id,
            hash_id_update_date,
            hash_email_update_date,
            record_source,
            load_date,
            creation_user
        FROM ''' || v_project_storage || '''.''' || v_dataset_master_stage || '''.tmp_base_iden_party_digital
    ),
    tab_2 as (
    SELECT

,cte_date_izipay_express_indicadores_dealer_parte_1 
as
(select  *
,'ITERACCION' as estado_iteraccion

, case 
when flag_completa_compraya = 'TERMINAR MÁS TARDE' and flag_listo != 1 then 'COTIZANDO' 
else null
end as estado_cotizando
-- cotizacion_desestimada

,case 
when trim(flag_completa_compraya) = 'TERMINAR MÁS TARDE' and flag_listo = 0 
and trim(opcion_tipo_producto) = 'SIN INTERES' 
-- and fase_caso_final in ('Caso desestimado', 'Caso cerrado por ejecutivo luego de CompraYa') 
then 'Cotización desestimada' 
else null
end as cotizacion_desestimada


,case 
when flag_completa_compraya = 'TERMINAR MÁS TARDE' and flag_listo != 1 
and cast(tiempo_visita as int64) >  9 
and not (opcion_tipo_producto = 'SIN INTERES'  and fase_caso_final in ('CASO DESESTIMADO', 'CASO CERRADO POR EJECUTIVO LUEGO DE COMPRAYA')) 
then 'COTIZACION VENCIDA' 
else null
end as cotizacion_vencida



-- cotizacion_guardada
,case 
when flag_completa_compraya = 'TERMINAR MÁS TARDE' and flag_listo != 1 
and cast(tiempo_visita as int64) <= 9 
and not (opcion_tipo_producto = 'SIN INTERES'  and fase_caso_final in ('CASO DESESTIMADO', 'CASO CERRADO POR EJECUTIVO LUEGO DE COMPRAYA')) 
then 'COTIZACION GUARDADA' 
else null 
end as cotizacion_guardada


-- estado_rechazado
,case 
when opcion_tipo_producto = 'SIN INTERES' then 'OFERTA RECHAZADA' 
else null 
end as estado_rechazado


,case 
when  process_date <= (select * from cte_max_listo_log) and     flag_listo = 1 then 'VENTA CERRADA'
when process_date > (select * from cte_max_listo_log) and  (fase_caso_final = 'Venta exitosa' or trim(flag_completa_compraya)  = 'LISTO' )   then 'VENTA CERRADA'

            when arn_transaccion = '74357045003001757523307' and num_caso_vrol = '5407262287' and cod_categoria_contracargo = '13' and cod_subcategoria_contracargo = '1' then 2

            when arn_transaccion = '74357045032003264219820' and num_caso_vrol = '5428843693' and cod_categoria_contracargo = '10' and cod_subcategoria_contracargo = '4' then 2

    where tipo_autenticacion = 'AUTENTICACION 3DS'
),
cte_mc as (
select
    --a.process_date                                                             as process_date,
    current_date('America/Lima') - 1                                             as process_date,        
    'MASTERCARD'                                                                 as marca_tarjeta,
    a.tipo_intercambio                                                           as juridisccion_trx,
    left(a.bin, 6)                                                               as bin,
    right(a.tarjeta_enmascarada,4)                                               as cuarteto,
    coalesce(UPPER(TRIM(bines.bancoemisor)), 'FORÁNEO')                          as bancor_emisor,
    a.fecha_ingreso                                                              as fecha_contracargo,
    a.cod_ica_emisor                                                             as cod_ica_emisor,
    a.cod_ica_adq                                                                as cod_ica_adq,
    a.cod_mti                                                                    as cod_mti,
    a.cod_funcion                                                                as cod_funcion,
    a.tarjeta_enmascarada                                                        as tarjeta_enmascarada,
    a.cod_tipo_contracargo                                                       as cod_tipo_contracargo,
    case
        when a.cod_moneda = 'SOL PERUANO'          then 'PEN'
        when a.cod_moneda = 'DOLAR ESTADOUNIDENSE' then 'USD'
    end                                                                          as moneda_contracargo,
    a.mto_contracargo                                                            as mto_contracargo,
    coalesce(liq.cod_autorizacion, a.cod_autorizacion_trx)                       as cod_autorizacion,
    a.nro_referencia_acq                                                         as arn_ard,
    coalesce(liq.cod_comercio, a.cod_comercio)                                   as cod_comercio,
    liq.nom_comercio                                                             as nom_comercio,
    a.nro_control                                                                as nro_control_contracargo,
    a.cod_razon                                                                  as cod_motivo_contracargo,
    motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo                                          as categoria_motivo_contracargo,
    a.pais_emisor                                                                as pais_emisor,
    a.mensaje_emisor                                                             as mensaje_emisor,
    a.estado_contracargo                                                         as estado_contracargo,
    a.fecha_estado_contracargo                                                   as fecha_estado_contracargo,
    a.cod_gestor                                                                 as cod_gestor,
    a.obs_regularizacion                                                         as obs_regularizacion,
    a.ind_unicidad_contracargo                                                   as ind_unicidad_contracargo,
    coalesce(dev.fecha_trx, liq.fecha_transaccion)                               as fecha_trx,
    coalesce(dev.fecha_proceso, liq.process_date)                                as fecha_proceso,
    coalesce(dev.moneda, liq.moneda)                                             as moneda_trx,
    coalesce(dev.mto_venta_bruto, liq.mto_venta)                                 as mto_trx,
    coalesce(dev.metodo_ingreso, liq.metodo_ingreso)                             as metodo_ingreso,
    liq.cod_respuesta_ecommerce                                                  as cod_respuesta_ecommerce,
    liq.voucher                                                                  as voucher,
    liq.cod_terminal                                                             as cod_terminal,
    liq.referencia                                                               as referencia,
    ret.fecha_retencion                                                          as fecha_retencion,
    ret.moneda                                                                   as moneda_retencion,
    ret.importetotaltrx                                                          as mto_retencion,
    dev.fecha_proceso                                                            as fecha_devolucion,
    dev.moneda                                                                   as moneda_devolucion,
    dev.mto_venta_bruto                                                          as mto_devolucion,
    comercio.party_id_izi                                                        as party_id_izi,
    comercio.razon_social                                                        as razon_social,
    a.mto_contracargo_sol                                                        as mto_contracargo_pen,
    comercio.nom_facilitador_pagos                                               as nom_facilitador_pagos,
    comercio.cod_segmento                                                        as cod_segmento,
    comercio.desc_situacion_comercio                                             as desc_situacion_comercio,
    comercio.nom_giro_comercio                                                   as desc_giro_comercio,
    case
        when a.mto_contracargo_sol <   100 then 'A.[0;100>'
        when a.mto_contracargo_sol <   350 then 'B.[100;350>'
        when a.mto_contracargo_sol <   500 then 'C.[350;500>'
        when a.mto_contracargo_sol <  1000 then 'D.[500;1k>'
        when a.mto_contracargo_sol <  2000 then 'E.[1k;2k>'
        when a.mto_contracargo_sol <  3000 then 'F.[2k;3k>'
        when a.mto_contracargo_sol >= 3000 then 'G.>=3K'
    end                                                                          as rango_mto_contracargo_pen,
    motivo.descripcion_motivo_contracargo                                        as motivo_cc,
    rev_mc.fecha_ingreso                                                         as fecha_reversa,
    row_number() over (
        partition by a.nro_referencia_acq, a.nro_control
        order by a.fecha_ingreso asc
    )                                                                            as orden_cc,
    case
        when motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo = 'ERRORES DE PROCESAMIENTO' then '3'
        when comercio.cod_segmento = 'N' and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo in ('FRUADE','SERVICIOS/MERCADERÍA - DISPUTAS DEL CONSUMIDOR') then '1'
        when comercio.cod_segmento = 'E' and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo in ('FRUADE','SERVICIOS/MERCADERÍA - DISPUTAS DEL CONSUMIDOR') then '2'
        when comercio.cod_segmento in ('G','C') and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo = 'FRUADE' then '3'
        when comercio.cod_segmento = 'N' and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo in ('ERRORES DE PROCESAMIENTO','AUTORIZACIÓN') then '4'
        when comercio.cod_segmento = 'E' and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo in ('ERRORES DE PROCESAMIENTO','AUTORIZACIÓN') then '5'
        when comercio.cod_segmento in ('G','C') and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo in ('ERRORES DE PROCESAMIENTO','AUTORIZACIÓN','SERVICIOS/MERCADERÍA - DISPUTAS DEL CONSUMIDOR') then '6'
    end                                                                          as prioridad_cc,
    case
        when mcommerce.cod_comercio like '3%' then 'CAJERO CORRESPONSAL'
        when mcommerce.flag_izipay_ya is true  then 'IZIPAY_YA'
        when (case
                when mcommerce.cod_contrato in ('IO-APP','IO-PLINK','IO-PLLINK','CSIO-PLINK','IO-PWEB','IO-WEB','SCIO-APP','SCIO-PLINK','SCIO-PWEB') then 'INTEROPERABILIDAD'
                when mcommerce.cod_contrato = 'NIUBIZ-AX' then 'NIUBIZ'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador = '254287' then 'FISICO'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador in ('179381','253254') then 'MIXTO'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador in ('259170','240269','240268','246359','351330','260551','268562','262802','264504','260874','261870','226282','226283','237436') then 'VIRTUAL'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador = '0' then 'PMP'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador = '253357' then 'IZIPAY'
                else 'SIN CLASIFICAR'
              end) = 'FISICO'   then 'FACILITADOR FISICO'
        when (case
                when mcommerce.cod_contrato in ('IO-APP','IO-PLINK','IO-PLLINK','CSIO-PLINK','IO-PWEB','IO-WEB','SCIO-APP','SCIO-PLINK','SCIO-PWEB') then 'INTEROPERABILIDAD'
                when mcommerce.cod_contrato = 'NIUBIZ-AX' then 'NIUBIZ'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador = '254287' then 'FISICO'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador in ('179381','253254') then 'MIXTO'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador in ('259170','240269','240268','246359','351330','260551','268562','262802','264504','260874','261870','226282','226283','237436') then 'VIRTUAL'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador = '0' then 'PMP'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador = '253357' then 'IZIPAY'
                else 'SIN CLASIFICAR'
              end) = 'VIRTUAL'  then 'FACILITADOR VIRTUAL'
        when (case
                when mcommerce.cod_contrato in ('IO-APP','IO-PLINK','IO-PLLINK','CSIO-PLINK','IO-PWEB','IO-WEB','SCIO-APP','SCIO-PLINK','SCIO-PWEB') then 'INTEROPERABILIDAD'
                when mcommerce.cod_contrato = 'NIUBIZ-AX' then 'NIUBIZ'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador = '254287' then 'FISICO'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador in ('179381','253254') then 'MIXTO'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador in ('259170','240269','240268','246359','351330','260551','268562','262802','264504','260874','261870','226282','226283','237436') then 'VIRTUAL'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador = '0' then 'PMP'
                when mcommerce.cod_facilitador = '253357' then 'IZIPAY'
                else 'SIN CLASIFICAR'
              end) = 'MIXTO'    then 'FACILITADOR MIXTO'
        when mcommerce.segmento_parque = 'MERCHANT'                                        then 'RETAIL'
        when mcommerce.segmento_parque = 'NEG'                                             then 'NEGOCIO'
        when mcommerce.segmento_parque = 'CORP'                                            then 'CORPORACIÓN'
        when mcommerce.segmento_parque is null and mcommerce.cod_segmento = 'E'            then 'NEGOCIO'
        when mcommerce.segmento_parque is null and mcommerce.cod_segmento in ('C','G')     then 'CORPORACIÓN'
        when mcommerce.segmento_parque is null                                             then 'RETAIL'
        when mcommerce.segmento_parque = 'SIN SEGMENTO'                                   then 'SIN SEGMENTO'
        else 'SIN_CLASIFICAR'
    end                                                                          as agrupacion_operaciones,
    case
        when (case when a.cod_moneda = 'SOL PERUANO' then 'PEN' when a.cod_moneda = 'DOLAR ESTADOUNIDENSE' then 'USD' end)
             = coalesce(dev.moneda, liq.moneda)
            then ABS(a.mto_contracargo - coalesce(dev.mto_venta_bruto, liq.mto_venta))
        when a.cod_moneda = 'SOL PERUANO'
            then a.mto_contracargo / coalesce(dev.mto_venta_bruto, liq.mto_venta)
        when a.cod_moneda = 'DOLAR ESTADOUNIDENSE'
            then coalesce(dev.mto_venta_bruto, liq.mto_venta) / a.mto_contracargo
    end                                                                          as tica,
    case
        when ctrl_c.party_id_izi is not null then 'L3'
        when ctrl_d.party_id_izi is not null then 'L3'
        when ctrl_e.party_id_izi is not null then 'L3'
        when a.ind_unicidad_contracargo <> 'CC UNICO' or a.ind_unicidad_contracargo is null then 'L3'
        when a.cod_tipo_contracargo = '20' then 'L3'
        when date_DIFF(a.fecha_ingreso, coalesce(dev.fecha_proceso, liq.process_date), DAY) >= 121 then 'L3'
        when (comercio.cod_segmento = 'N' and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo in ('FRUADE','SERVICIOS/MERCADERÍA - DISPUTAS DEL CONSUMIDOR'))
          or (comercio.cod_segmento = 'E' and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo in ('FRUADE','SERVICIOS/MERCADERÍA - DISPUTAS DEL CONSUMIDOR'))
          or (comercio.cod_segmento = 'N' and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo in ('ERRORES DE PROCESAMIENTO','AUTORIZACIÓN'))
          or (comercio.cod_segmento = 'E' and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo in ('ERRORES DE PROCESAMIENTO','AUTORIZACIÓN'))
          or (comercio.cod_segmento in ('G','C') and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo in ('ERRORES DE PROCESAMIENTO','AUTORIZACIÓN','SERVICIOS/MERCADERÍA - DISPUTAS DEL CONSUMIDOR'))
            then 'L3'
        when (motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo = 'ERRORES DE PROCESAMIENTO')
          or (comercio.cod_segmento in ('G','C') and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo = 'FRUADE'
              and dev.fecha_proceso is not null and motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo = 'FRAUDE')
            then 'L3'
        when comercio.cod_giro_comercio in ('4511','3030','4722','5592','7512','3502','3533','7011','3548','7542','3509','3642','3519','3649','3503','3591','3513','6012')
            then 'L3'
        when ctrl_i.party_id_izi is not null then 'L3'
        when a.cod_funcion = 'RDR' then 'L3'
        when CONCAT(coalesce(dev.metodo_ingreso, liq.metodo_ingreso), motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo) = 'PQFRAUDE' then 'L3'
        when CONCAT(LEFT(motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo, 1), LEFT(liq.cod_respuesta_ecommerce, 3)) = 'F211' then 'L3'
        when CONCAT(LEFT(motivo.categoria_motivo_contracargo, 1), LEFT(liq.cod_respuesta_ecommerce, 3)) = 'F212' then 'L3'
        when liq.cod_terminal in ('00000007','00000006') then 'L3'
        when j_3ds.cod_comercio is not null then 'L3'
        else 'L1'
    end                                                                          as linea_atencion,
    case
        when (case when a.cod_moneda = 'SOL PERUANO' then 'PEN' when a.cod_moneda = 'DOLAR ESTADOUNIDENSE' then 'USD' end)
               = coalesce(dev.moneda, liq.moneda)
          and (case

            from `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_master_party||"""."""||var_table_m_comercio||"""` a

            from `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_master_party||"""."""||var_table_m_comercio||"""` a

            qualify row_number() over(partition by a.party_id_izi_representante, a.cod_comercio order by a.fecha_bloqueo_comercio asc) = 1
            union all
            select

  ), coincidencia_2 as
  (
    select

    from coincidencia a

    ,if(a.flag_cuenta_bancaria = 1, true, false) as flag_cuenta_bancaria
    ,if(a.flag_cliente = 1, true, false) as flag_cliente
    ,if(a.flag_representante = 1, true, false) as flag_representante
    ,if(a.flag_ruc10_dni = 1, true, false) as flag_ruc10_dni
    ,b.flag_bloqueo_fraude
    ,'M_COMERCIO, COMERCIOS BLOQUEADOS' as record_source
    ,current_datetime("America/Lima") as load_date
    ,session_user() as creation_user
  from coincidencia_2 a
  left join `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_master_party||"""."""||var_table_m_comercio||"""` b on a.cod_comercio = b.cod_comercio
  left join `"""||var_project_sensitive||"""."""||var_dataset_master_pii||"""."""||var_table_iden_party_data_control||"""` c on (b.party_id_izi = c.party_id_izi)

   --=== declaracion de variables de calculo de ratios ============

          declare ir_debito           float64  default 0.8 / 100.0 ;
          declare ir_credito          float64  default 1.2 / 100.0 ;
          declare costo_marca_debito  float64  default 0.10 / 100.0 ;
          declare costo_marca_credito float64  default 0.16 / 100.0 ;
          declare peso_fisico         float64  default 0.7 ;
          declare float_arisale       float64  default 7.0;
          declare factor_1            float64  default 0.35;
          declare factor_2            float64  default 0.41 / 100.0;
          declare mdr_arisale_default float64  default 3.0 / 100.0;

           /*  dar formato a var periodo */
          SET query = """
          select  FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', '"""||var_fecha||"""'  )     ; 
          """;
          EXECUTE IMMEDIATE(query)
          into var_periodo;




          /* Crear la query de insersion hacia la tabla destino */

          SET query_insert = """
            insert into `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_storage_business||"""."""||var_table_dv_bd_ratio||"""`
            (
              process_date
              ,itc_company_id
              ,itc_company_name
              ,nro_ruc
              ,mdr_td_tc_c_qr_new
              ,mdr_td_tc_c_qr_ari_new
              ,mdr_qr
              ,sva
              ,td_regular
              ,tc_regular
              ,tf_regular
              ,qr_regular
              ,dq_flag_ind
              ,dq_control_msg
              ,dq_config_id
              ,hk_diff
              ,start_date
              ,end_date
              ,flag_active
              ,record_source
              ,load_date
              ,creation_user
            ) 

            /*================================== Proceso DDL  =========================================== 
            Identificacion y preprocesamiento de la informacion necesaria para utilizarla en las logicas
            del cotizador mediantes cte's 
            ===========================================================================================*/

            /*
            a. Logica de agrupacion de transacciones de los ultimos n meses segun la variable ventana_informacion.
            Informacion agrupada por codigo_comercio , documento , tipo de tarjeta(credito o debito),medio de transaccion
            (presencial o virtual) y marca.
            Sumarizando los campos de :
            - importe          : Monto de la transacción en soles
            Ingresos :
            - comisioncomercio : Comisión que cobra Izipay en su Rol Adquiriente o Facilitador al comercio 
            - comisionflat     : Comisión por transacción, es decir, tarifas únicas, (importes solarizado)
            Egresos :
            - intercambio      : Costo de adquiriencia que se posee por Visa y Mastercard por transacción
            - costo de marca   : Costo por procesar transacciones visa o mastercard
            */

            WITH cte_transaccionesagrupadas_final AS
            (
              SELECT 
                trx.pdcest AS codigoestablecimiento 
                ,estab.nro_ruc AS nroruc
                ,date_trunc(trx.process_date, month) as periodo
                ,pdmetr AS medio_transaccion
                ,
                --- Logica Heredada de Detalle de Transacciones de SQL Onpremise (Presente y No Presente)
                CASE
                  WHEN TRIM (pdterm) IN ('00000007')                         THEN 'VIRTUAL'
                  WHEN TRIM (pdterm) IN ('00000003') and pdmetr = 'EC'       THEN 'FISICO' -- Antes Presente
                  WHEN TRIM (pduser) IN ('PAGOEFE')                          THEN 'VIRTUAL'
                  WHEN TRIM (pdmetr) IN ('PQ', 'QA')                         THEN 'VIRTUAL'
                  WHEN TRIM (pduser) IN ('PAYZEN')                           THEN 'VIRTUAL'
                  WHEN TRIM (pduser) IN ('SMART')                            THEN 'FISICO'
                  WHEN TRIM (pdmetr) IN ('CA', 'EC', 'MT', 'PV', 'VM', 'VU') THEN 'VIRTUAL' -- Antes No Presente 
                  ELSE 'FISICO' 
                END AS tipo_medio_transaccion
                ,CASE
                  WHEN subtipo_tarjeta LIKE '%Crédito%' THEN 'Crédito'
                  ELSE 'Débito' 
                END AS tipo_tarjeta
                ,marca AS marca
                ,sum(importe)       as importe 
                ,sum(com_comercio)  as comisioncomercio
                ,sum(com_flat)      as comisionflat
                ,sum(intercambio)   as intercambio
                ,sum(costo_marca)   as costomarca
              FROM  `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_storage_master_transaction||"""."""||var_table_t_detalle_transacciones||"""`  trx
              LEFT JOIN `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_storage_master_placement||"""."""||var_table_m_parque||"""`  estab  
              ON trx.pdcest = CAST(estab.codigo as string)
              where date_trunc(trx.process_date, month) between  date_trunc (date_add(date  '"""||var_fecha||"""'     , INTERVAL -3 month), month) -- var periodo 
              and   date_trunc('"""||var_fecha||"""',month)  
              GROUP BY 
                trx.pdcest
                ,estab.nro_ruc
                ,date_trunc(trx.process_date, month) 
                ,pdmetr
                ,case
                  WHEN TRIM (pdterm) IN ('00000007')                         THEN 'VIRTUAL'
                  WHEN TRIM (pdterm) IN ('00000003') and pdmetr = 'EC'       THEN 'FISICO' -- Antes Presente
                  WHEN TRIM (pduser) IN ('PAGOEFE')                          THEN 'VIRTUAL'
                  WHEN TRIM (pdmetr) IN ('PQ', 'QA')                         THEN 'VIRTUAL'
                  WHEN TRIM (pduser) IN ('PAYZEN')                           THEN 'VIRTUAL'
                  WHEN TRIM (pduser) IN ('SMART')                            THEN 'FISICO'
                  WHEN TRIM (pdmetr) IN ('CA', 'EC', 'MT', 'PV', 'VM', 'VU') THEN 'VIRTUAL' -- Antes No Presente 
                  ELSE 'FISICO' 
                end  
                ,CASE
                  WHEN subtipo_tarjeta LIKE '%Crédito%' THEN 'Crédito'
                  ELSE 'Débito' 
                END
                ,marca
            )
            /*
            b. Logica de agrupacion de la tabla de establecimiento (mcestab) filtrando creando una marca para los establecimientos con IBK 
            en banca privada.
            agripado por codigo de establecimiento y numero de ruc.
            */
            ,cte_mcestab_final AS
            (
              SELECT
                nroruc
                ,codigo
                ,c_visa
                ,c_vi_debito
                ,c_mastercard
                ,c_mc_debito,
                CASE 
                  WHEN (bcopag) = 3 THEN 1 --- IbkPrivada
                  ELSE 0
                END AS flag_ibk
              FROM `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_storage_master_placement||"""."""||var_table_m_establecimiento||"""` 
            )
            /*
            c. Logica para obtener la ultima comision QR en tasa por codigo de comercio afiliado a qr
            por aplicativo  (QR=1) | Tap to phone : 2 (nfc del celular) ;
            */
            ,CTE_OfertaAcumuladaQR_Final AS
            (
              SELECT 
                DISTINCT codigo AS codigo_comercio
                ,min(comflat) AS tasa_qr 
              FROM          `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_storage_master_transaction||"""."""||var_table_m_modulo_tarifa||"""`  -- Tabla Temporal .
              WHERE cod_medio_trx = '1'  -- Validado por Nilo Ponce .
              group by codigo
            )
            /*
            d. Logica de agrupacion de la tabla de dv_bd_comercios de negocios y empresas 
            por numero de ruc y segmento utilizando la ultima fecha de procesamiento . 
            */
            ,cte_cotizador_final AS
            (
              SELECT 
                DISTINCT
                com.nro_ruc
                ,parque.segmento_parque 
              FROM  `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_storage_business||"""."""||var_table_dv_bd_comercio||"""`   com
              LEFT JOIN `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_storage_master_placement||"""."""||var_table_m_parque||"""`   parque 
              ON com.codigo = parque.codigo 
            )

            ------------------------------------Parte #2----------------------------------------------
            -- Calcular los parametros para el calculo de Ratios con la fuentes precalculadas anteriormente|1:
            -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            /*
            e. Logica para transacciones del mundo fisico agrupados por ruc , codigo  y marca (MasterCard y Visa)
            y tipos de tarjeta(Credito y Debito) donde se calcula el MDR (Merchant Discount Rate) y la suma de las transacciones
            en los ultimos n meses segun la variable de venta_informacion, 
            La formula del MRD aplicada en el ejercicio es la siguiente :

              MDR_Fisico = Comision_Comercio + Comision_Flat
              • comision flat     : izipay cololca la comision por cada transaccion (monto fijo)
              • comision comercio : comision de la compra en la transaccion (monto variable)
            */
            ,cte_montos_transacciones_fisico AS
            (
              SELECT
                nroruc AS ruc,
                codigoestablecimiento AS codigo,
                marca,
                tipo_tarjeta,
                SUM(importe) AS  importefisico ,
                SUM(comisioncomercio + comisionflat) AS  mdrfisico_monto 
              FROM
              cte_transaccionesagrupadas_final
              WHERE
              tipo_medio_transaccion = 'FISICO'
              AND tipo_tarjeta IN ('Crédito', 'Débito')
              AND marca IN ('Visa', 'Mastercard')
              GROUP BY
                nroruc,
                codigoestablecimiento,
                marca,
                tipo_tarjeta
            )
            /*
            f. Logica para transacciones del mundo qr  agrupados por ruc , codigo  (MasterCard y Visa)
            y tipos de tarjeta(Credito y Debito) donde se calcula el MDR (Merchant Discount Rate) y la suma de las transacciones
            en los ultimos n meses segun la variable de venta_informacion, 
            La formula del MRD aplicada en el ejercicio es la siguiente :

              MDR_QR = Comision_Comercio + Comision_Flat
              • comision flat     : izipay cololca la comision por cada transaccion (monto fijo)
              • comision comercio : comision de la compra en la transaccion (monto variable)
            Se utilizara el mdr_qr para identidficar la oportunidad de los comercios con QR y cual es el % de comercios que transaccionan QR .
            */ 
            ,cte_montostransaccionesqr
            AS
            (
            SELECT
                nroruc AS ruc,
                codigoestablecimiento as codigo,  
                SUM(importe) AS `ImporteQR`,
                SUM(comisioncomercio + comisionflat) AS mdrqrmonto
              FROM cte_transaccionesagrupadas_final
              WHERE TRIM(medio_transaccion) IN ('QA','PQ') -- Codigos QR AS400
              AND tipo_tarjeta IN ('Crédito', 'Débito')    
              AND marca IN ('Visa', 'Mastercard')
              GROUP BY
                nroruc,
                codigoestablecimiento 
            )
            /*
            g. Logica para transformar de columnas a filas las marcas y el tipo de tarjetas   del maestro de establecimientos  
            por numero de ruc , codigo de establecimiento  , tasa por marca y tipo de tarjeta.
            */ 
            ,cte_tasas_p0 AS (
              SELECT
                nroruc,
                codigo,
                CASE
                  WHEN variable = 'c_visa' THEN 'Visa'
                  WHEN variable = 'c_vi_debito' THEN 'Visa'
                  WHEN variable = 'c_mastercard' THEN 'Mastercard'
                  WHEN variable = 'c_mc_debito' THEN 'Mastercard'
                END AS marca,
                CASE
                  WHEN variable = 'c_visa' THEN 'Crédito'
                  WHEN variable = 'c_mastercard' THEN 'Crédito'
                  WHEN variable = 'c_vi_debito' THEN 'Débito'
                  WHEN variable = 'c_mc_debito' THEN 'Débito'
                END AS tipo_tarjeta,
                CAST(value AS FLOAT64) AS tasa
              FROM
              cte_mcestab_final
              UNPIVOT (
              value FOR variable IN (c_visa, c_vi_debito, c_mastercard, c_mc_debito)
            )
            /*
            h. Limpieza de logica anterior  cte_tasas_p0 para corregir los numeros de documento de los establecimientos
            */ 

            )
            ,cte_tasas_final AS (
              SELECT
                CASE
                  WHEN LENGTH(nroruc) = 9 AND STARTS_WITH(nroruc, '00') THEN SUBSTR(nroruc, 2)
                  ELSE nroruc
                END AS nroruc,
                codigo,
                marca,
                tipo_tarjeta,
                tasa
              FROM cte_tasas_p0
            )
            /*
            i. Calcular el mdr del mundo fisico teorico en funcion a los parametros de intercambio vigentes
            tasas de intercambio estimadas por tipo de tarjeta. 
            Los parametros de ir son estimaciones que se agregan por defecto a la logica:
            • 0.008 para debito (rango tipico de 0,5% a 1,2%)
            • 0.012 para credito (rangos hasta 3%) ; 
            + https://www.mastercard.com.pe/es-pe/empresas/empresas-pequenas-medianas/soporte/intercambio.html 
            + https://www.visa.com.pe/content/dam/VCOM/regional/lac/SPA/peru/tasa-de-intercambio/Publicacion-TarifadeIntercambio-Visa-PERU-V2-CP.pdf 

            Los parametros de costo de marca son estimaciones que se agregan por defecto a la logica
            Se utiliza para poder estimar el gasto por transaccion del banco receptor por tipo de tarjeta  de la transaccion hacia izipay
            • 0.001  para debito  
            • 0.0016 para credito  

            El mdrfisicomontoteorico describe cuanto es el monto que el comercio esta asumiendo por cada transaccion 
            en funcion a la informacion declarada en el maestro de establecimientos.
            • Observacion : Se debe de revisar el calculo actual debido a que se encuentra sumarizando los importes
                    en funcion a una tasa que pudo haber cambiado en los ultimos 3 meses .

            Oportunidad de mejoras : 
            •traer el campo real pd_pcom porcentaje de comision  -- es mas preciso .
            */ 
            ,cte_parametros_montos_fisicos_0 AS 
            (
              SELECT * ,
                importefisico*(tasas.tasa/100) AS mdrfisicomontoteorico
                ,CASE 
                  WHEN tfisico.tipo_tarjeta  = 'Débito'   THEN   """||ir_debito||"""  
                  WHEN tfisico.tipo_tarjeta  = 'Crédito'  THEN   """||ir_credito||"""         
                END  AS ir_fisico_tasa_teorico
                ,CASE 
                  WHEN tfisico.tipo_tarjeta  = 'Débito' THEN   """||costo_marca_debito||"""   
                  WHEN tfisico.tipo_tarjeta  = 'Crédito' THEN  """||costo_marca_credito||"""      
                END  AS costo_marca_fisico_tasa_teorico
              FROM  cte_montos_transacciones_fisico tfisico 
              LEFT JOIN  cte_tasas_final tasas ON tfisico.ruc =  tasas.nroruc 
              AND  CAST(tfisico.codigo AS STRING)  = CAST(tasas.codigo AS STRING)
              AND  CAST(tfisico.tipo_tarjeta AS STRING)  = CAST(tasas.tipo_tarjeta AS STRING)
              AND  CAST(tfisico.marca AS STRING)  = CAST(tasas.marca AS STRING)  
            )
            /*
            j. Calcular el costo de la tasa de intercambio (ir_fisico_monto_teorico) que es
            cuanto cuesta procesar una transaccion con tarjeta fisica de forma teorica.
            adiconal calcular el costo fisico por marca (costo_marca_fisico_monto_teorico)
            */ 
            ,cte_parametros_montos_fisicos_1 AS 
            (
              SELECT 
                *
                ,importefisico*ir_fisico_tasa_teorico AS ir_fisico_monto_teorico
                ,importefisico*costo_marca_fisico_tasa_teorico AS costo_marca_fisico_monto_teorico
              FROM cte_parametros_montos_fisicos_0
            )
            /*
            k. Sumarizar y agrupar los indicadores del mundo fisico por numero de ruc del comercio.
            • importefisico : Volumen total en soles de las ventas
            • mdrfisico_monto : Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) , monto total de tarifa  solarizada .
            • mdrfisicomontoteorico : cuanto del monto del mundo fisico asume el comercio en funcion al volumen
                              de transacciones , y la tasa aplicada por marca y tipo en el maestro de establecimientos
            • ir_fisico_monto_teorico : cuanto del monto del mundo fisico asume el comercio en funcion al volumen de venta de las transacciones
            por tipo de tarjeta este es un campo monetario.
            • costo_marca_fisico_monto_teorico :es el costo sumarizo que se paga a la marca(visa o mastercard) por volumen de transaccion.
            */         
            ,cte_parametros_montos_fisicos_2 AS 
            (
              SELECT
                ruc
                ,SUM(importefisico) AS importefisico
                ,SUM(mdrfisico_monto) AS mdrfisico_monto
                ,SUM(mdrfisicomontoteorico) AS mdrfisicomontoteorico
                ,SUM(ir_fisico_monto_teorico) AS ir_fisico_monto_teorico
                ,SUM(costo_marca_fisico_monto_teorico) AS costo_marca_fisico_monto_teorico
              FROM
              cte_parametros_montos_fisicos_1
              GROUP BY ruc
            )
            /*
            l. Calcular las tasas (en porcentajes/100) de mdr , ir y costo de marca fisico teorico
            */ 
            ,cte_parametros_montos_fisicos_final AS 
            (
              SELECT
                *
                ,SAFE_DIVIDE (mdrfisico_monto, importefisico) *100.0 AS  mdr_fisico_tasa   -- check
                ,SAFE_DIVIDE(mdrfisicomontoteorico, importefisico) *100.0 AS  mdr_fisico_tasa_teorico  -- renew
                ,SAFE_DIVIDE(ir_fisico_monto_teorico, importefisico) *100.0 AS  ir_fisico_tasa_teorico  -- renew
                ,SAFE_DIVIDE(costo_marca_fisico_monto_teorico, importefisico)*100.0 AS  costo_marca_fisico_tasa --teorico  
                ,mdrfisico_monto  - mdrfisicomontoteorico  AS  mdr_fisico_diff   
              FROM cte_parametros_montos_fisicos_2
            )
            /*
            m. extraer la informacion de tasas qr en caso no tengan los clientes una tasa qr 
            solo para tarjetas de debito y marca visa.
            • Esto sirve para calcular el costo de oportunidad de qr en funcion a una tasa de tajreta debito .
            • La minima tasa por qr para no generar mas impcato al comercio .
            • No entra mastercar por share de visa (80%) .
            */ 
            , cte_tasas_visa_debito AS
            (
              SELECT
                codigo,
                MIN(tasa) AS tasa_qr_reemplazo
              FROM
              cte_tasas_final
              WHERE
              tipo_tarjeta = 'Débito'
              AND marca = 'Visa'
              GROUP BY
                codigo
            )
            ,cte_parametros_montos_qr_0 AS (
              SELECT
                m.ruc,
                m.codigo,
                m.importeqr,
                COALESCE(CAST(tq.tasa_qr AS FLOAT64), tq_reemplazo.tasa_qr_reemplazo) AS tasaqr,
                m.mdrqrmonto,
                COALESCE(CAST(tq.tasa_qr AS FLOAT64), tq_reemplazo.tasa_qr_reemplazo) * m.importeqr / 100.0 AS mdr_qr_monto_teorico
              FROM cte_montostransaccionesqr AS m
              LEFT JOIN cte_ofertaacumuladaqr_final AS tq ON m.codigo = tq.codigo_comercio
              LEFT JOIN cte_tasas_visa_debito AS tq_reemplazo ON CAST(m.codigo AS STRING) = CAST(tq_reemplazo.codigo AS STRING)
            )
            ,cte_parametros_montos_qr_1 AS 
            (
              SELECT
                ruc,
                SUM(importeqr) AS importe_qr,
                SUM(mdrqrmonto) AS mdr_qr_monto,
                SUM(mdr_qr_monto_teorico) AS mdr_qr_monto_teorico
              FROM
              cte_parametros_montos_qr_0
              GROUP BY
                ruc
            )
            ,cte_parametros_montos_qr_final AS 
            (
            SELECT
                ruc,
                SUM(importe_qr) AS importe_qr,
                SUM(mdr_qr_monto) AS mdr_qr_monto,
                SUM(mdr_qr_monto_teorico) AS mdr_qr_monto_teorico,
                (SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(mdr_qr_monto), SUM(importe_qr)) * 100.0) AS mdr_qr_tasa,
                (SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(mdr_qr_monto_teorico), SUM(importe_qr)) * 100.0) AS mdr_qr_tasa_teorico,
                ABS(SUM(mdr_qr_monto) - SUM(mdr_qr_monto_teorico)) AS mdr_qr_dif
              FROM cte_parametros_montos_qr_1
              GROUP BY
                ruc
            )
            ,cte_parametros_final_fisico_qr AS 
            (
              SELECT
                f.ruc,
                f.importefisico,
                f.mdrfisico_monto,
                f.mdrfisicomontoteorico,
                f.ir_fisico_monto_teorico,
                f.mdr_fisico_tasa,
                f.costo_marca_fisico_monto_teorico,
                COALESCE(q.importe_qr, 0) AS importe_qr
              FROM cte_parametros_montos_fisicos_final f
              LEFT JOIN cte_parametros_montos_qr_final q ON f.ruc = q.ruc
            )
            ,cte_flag_ibk_empresas AS 
            (
              SELECT
                nroruc,
                CASE 
                  WHEN SUM(flag_ibk) > 0 THEN TRUE
                  ELSE FALSE
                END AS flag_ibk
              FROM cte_mcestab_Final
              GROUP BY 
                nroruc
            )
            ------------------------------------logica #3----------------------------------------------
            -- Calculo de Spreads  :
            -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            ,cte_spread_0 AS 
            (
              SELECT
                f.ruc,
                f.importefisico,
                f.importe_qr,
                f.mdrfisicomontoteorico,
                f.ir_fisico_monto_teorico,
                f.costo_marca_fisico_monto_teorico,
                f.mdr_fisico_tasa,
                c.segmento_parque AS segmento
              FROM cte_parametros_final_fisico_qr AS f
              LEFT JOIN cte_cotizador_final AS c ON f.ruc = c.nro_ruc
              WHERE c.segmento_parque = 'NEG'
            )
            ,cte_spread_1 AS 
            (
              SELECT 
                ruc,
                importefisico,
                importe_qr,
                mdrfisicomontoteorico,
                ir_fisico_monto_teorico,
                costo_marca_fisico_monto_teorico,
                (importefisico + importe_qr) AS importe_total,
                (mdrfisicomontoteorico - ir_fisico_monto_teorico - costo_marca_fisico_monto_teorico) AS spread_fisico_monto_teorico,
                (SAFE_DIVIDE(importe_qr, (importefisico + importe_qr))) AS participacion_qr,
                (importefisico / 3) AS importe_fisico_prom_u3m,
                ((mdrfisicomontoteorico - ir_fisico_monto_teorico - costo_marca_fisico_monto_teorico) / 3) AS spread_fisico_prom_u3m
              FROM cte_spread_0
            )
            ,cte_spread_2 AS 
            (
                SELECT 
                  c.*,
                  CASE
                    WHEN importe_qr > 0 THEN TRUE
                    ELSE FALSE
                  END AS flag_qr,
                  CASE 
                    WHEN importe_qr > 0 THEN (SAFE_DIVIDE(importe_fisico_prom_u3m, ("""||peso_fisico||""" + participacion_qr)))  
                    ELSE (SAFE_DIVIDE(importe_fisico_prom_u3m, """||peso_fisico||"""))                        
                  END AS vol_nuevo
              FROM cte_spread_1 c
            )
            ,cte_spread_3 AS 
            (
            SELECT 
              * ,
              (vol_nuevo * """||factor_1||""" * """||factor_2||"""  ) AS float_nuevo,
              (spread_fisico_prom_u3m - (vol_nuevo * """||factor_1||"""   *  """||factor_2||""" )) AS dif_oferta_qr,
              (spread_fisico_prom_u3m - (vol_nuevo * """||factor_1||"""   *  """||factor_2||"""  ) - """||float_arisale||""") AS dif_oferta_qr_c_arisale,   
              SAFE_DIVIDE((spread_fisico_prom_u3m - (vol_nuevo * """||factor_1||"""   * """||factor_2||"""  )), importe_fisico_prom_u3m) AS mdr_oferta_qr
            FROM cte_spread_2
            )
            ,cte_spread_final AS 
            (
              SELECT 
                ruc,
                mdr_oferta_qr,
                CASE 
                  WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(dif_oferta_qr_c_arisale, importe_fisico_prom_u3m) < 0 THEN """||mdr_arisale_default||"""   --   
                  ELSE SAFE_DIVIDE(dif_oferta_qr_c_arisale, importe_fisico_prom_u3m)
                END AS mdr_oferta_qr_c_arisale
              FROM cte_spread_3
            )
            ,cte_var_dv_bd_comercio as
            (
            select  
              codigo
              ,segmento_id FROM `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_storage_business||"""."""||var_table_dv_bd_comercio||"""`
            where process_date =  '"""||var_fecha||"""'
            
            )
            ------------------------------------logica #4----------------------------------------------
            -- Insersion Final   :
            -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            SELECT 
              distinct
               pc.process_date               AS process_date  
              ,'086'                        AS itc_company_id  
              ,'IZIPAY'                     AS itc_company_name  
              ,p.nro_ruc AS nro_ruc
              ,mdr.MDR_Oferta_QR            AS mdr_td_tc_c_qr_new
              ,mdr.MDR_Oferta_QR_c_Arisale  AS mdr_td_tc_c_qr_ari_new
              ,0 AS mdr_qr  
              ,
              CASE
              WHEN segmento_id = 1 then 'Arisale S/. 59 con 2 meses gratis'
              WHEN segmento_id = 2 then 'Arisale S/. 59 con 3 meses gratis'
              WHEN segmento_id = 3 then 'Arisale S/. 59 con 1 mes gratis'
              WHEN segmento_id = 4 then 'Arisale S/. 59'
              ELSE 'Arisale S/. 59'

              END
              AS sva
              ,3.44 AS td_regular 
              ,3.44 AS tc_regular
              ,4.09 AS tf_regular
              ,1.25 AS qr_regular
              ,  TRUE                                        as dq_flag_ind
              ,'' AS dq_control_msg
              ,'' AS dq_config_id
              ,sha256(p.nro_ruc)                                        as hk_diff
              ,cast( current_date ('America/Lima')as timestamp)                         as start_date
              ,cast( current_date ('America/Lima')as timestamp)                         as end_date
              ,cast(1  as bool)                                      as flag_active
              ,'master'                                              as record_source
              ,cast(current_datetime('America/Lima') as timestamp)   as load_date
              ,session_user()                                        as creation_user
            FROM `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_storage_business||"""."""||var_table_dv_potencial_cuenta||"""`  pc 
            inner JOIN     `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_storage_master_placement||"""."""||var_table_m_parque ||"""` p 
            ON  pc.codigo = p.codigo  
            LEFT JOIN cte_var_dv_bd_comercio   c on CAST(pc.CODIGO AS STRING  ) = c.codigo
            inner JOIN cte_spread_final mdr on  p.nro_ruc = mdr.ruc
            WHERE  (pc.process_date ) = '"""||var_fecha||"""'  
          """;

    --=== Flujo de ejecucion de enmallado ============

--- flujo regular sin reprocesar periodos : 
if var_reproceso = 0
then
    /* borrar los datos del dia anterior de la ejecucion   antes de insertar los nuevos datos validando que no sea  las fechas que son cierre de mes */
    if var_fecha <> date_add (   date_add(date_trunc (var_fecha, month   ) , interval 1 month),  interval -1 day ) -- omite el delete para el ultimo mes del dia .
    then
        set query_delete = """
        delete from  `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_storage_business||"""."""||var_table_dv_bd_ratio||"""` 
        where process_date = date_add('"""||var_fecha||"""', interval -1 day) -- Eliminar los registros del dia anterior. current_date()-1
        """;
        execute immediate(query_delete);
    end if ;

    /* insertar los datos a la tabla destino*/ 
    execute immediate(query_insert);

--- flujo de reproceos de datos periodos : 
else 
    set query_reproceso = """
        delete from  `"""||var_project_storage||"""."""||var_dataset_storage_business||"""."""||var_table_dv_bd_ratio||"""` 
        where process_date = ('"""||var_fecha||"""') 
        """;
    execute immediate(query_reproceso);
    execute immediate(query_insert);

end if ;


END
